program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?))
    (define (rot cells) (norm (rotate-cells-cw cells)))
    (define ctrl (cond [(not (empty? (find-color g 2))) 2]
                       [(not (empty? (find-color g 3))) 3]
                       [(not (empty? (find-color g 4))) 4]
                       [(not (empty? (find-color g 6))) 6]
                       [else 2]))
    (define times (cond [(= ctrl 2) 0] [(= ctrl 3) 1] [(= ctrl 4) 2] [else 3]))
    (define shape
      (let loop ((k times) (cells (norm (find-color g 1))))
        (if (= k 0) cells (loop (- k 1) (rot cells)))))
    (define p7 (first (find-color g 7)))
    (define p8 (first (find-color g 8)))
    (define dr (- (first p8) (first p7)))
    (define dc (- (second p8) (second p7)))
    (let loop ((top (first p8)) (left (second p8)) (out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)))
      (let ((placed (map (lambda (p) (list (+ top (first p)) (+ left (second p)))) shape)))
        (if (all? (lambda (p) (and (pos-in-bounds? p (rows g) (cols g)) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 5)))) placed)
            (loop (+ top dr) (+ left dc) (paint-cells out placed 9))
            out)))))
